acceptanceCriteria.text: Successful final boss receipt marks towerSession and towerStatus complete immediately and Dashboard shows Done.
Regular battle wins, failed RPCs, boss losses and merely entering the boss floor never imply completion.
Daily reset and newer run snapshots clear previous completion; tests, typecheck and build pass.

checkpointPayload.description: Dashboard can remain pending after a confirmed win in the boss room when optional completion/briefInfo sidecars are absent. Reconcile canonical Tower completion from accepted boss victory and ensure daily Dashboard state follows it.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Reproduce final boss receipt without completion sidecars and retained session state. 2. Recognize confirmed boss victory in reducer and Dashboard fallback without marking regular wins/losses complete. 3. Verify newer run/reset invalidation, tests, typecheck and build; update status documentation.
checkpointPayload.title: Mark Dashboard Tower complete after final boss victory

taskChanges.newValue: Reproduced false completed flag with accepted boss-room win lacking optional completion sidecars. Reducer now marks canonical completion on confirmed boss victory and records room type; Dashboard recovers existing current-floor boss-win history while respecting daily observation time and newer reset. Rejected/missing responses, regular wins, losses and merely entering boss floor are covered. System Decision Impact: none — corrects final boss handling within the existing evidence-based Tower completion model, without adding a new architecture or dispatch policy.
